scope: Fifth batch AST compatibility only: an explicit fixed-node/field canonical AST representation, shared by CPython 3.11 and 3.12, with absent/empty FunctionDef.type_params treated identically and every other semantic field preserved or rejected.

finite_cases.case: One literal FunctionDef AST, represented with explicit CPython 3.11 fields and CPython 3.12 fields plus empty type_params, produces identical canonical bytes without mutating either input. One enumerated integer-value change changes its hash.
Four fixed rejection variants: nonempty type_params, an unexpected declared semantic field, an unexpected instance semantic attribute, and an unsupported AST node kind.

Read the exact frozen constructor source as inert bytes, select its 19 AST nodes, and verify the same revised AST metadata for explicitly represented 3.11 and 3.12 FunctionDef forms. Verify frozen raw blob/hash/size pins and source-span pins remain exact. Reject fixed unknown canonical schema, altered AST hash and altered raw-span hash metadata.

metadata_policy: Change only constructor AST canonicalization metadata and AST hashes in source-manifest.json. Preserve every file blob/SHA256/size/import pin, all selected source line/span hashes, external bindings, constructor source identity, runtime, caps and scientific semantics. AST parsing and metadata derivation are permitted; no constructor bytecode compilation or execution is permitted.
test_execution: This worker writes the plan, implementation, metadata and tests without running tests. Only source parsing, static metadata generation and AST/JSON syntax checks are performed here. The parent runs the authorized combined suite.
